parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the driver. On the **Driver Management** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: DriverVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the driver. If this parameter is left empty, the latest version of the driver is used by default.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: OrderId
parameters.description:
The order ID.

> This parameter is required when the driver is a purchased driver. This parameter is not required when the driver is an official or self-developed driver.
